grounding.states: No single 5-year fixed rate; depends on lender and whether the mortgage is insured (under 20% down)
grounding.from: No official, single "the" 5-year fixed rate exists. The figure depends on the lender and on whether the mortgage is insured (down payment under 20%) or uninsured.

grounding.states: Lowest insured 5-year fixed rate in Canada: 4.34%
grounding.from: Ratehub lists the best high-ratio (insured) 5-year fixed rate in Canada at 4.34%. Wowa gives the same 4.34% as the lowest insured 5-year fixed rate.
Ratehub's table (updated October 13) shows a Big 6 bank at 4.54% and Scotiabank at 4.74%.

grounding.states: Rates have been climbing since early September
grounding.from: Rates are climbing in October 2026, after all six of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September.

value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or not. The lowest insured one I found is 4.34%, a Canada-wide figure, not one for Toronto specifically. Big banks are higher, with one at 4.54% and Scotiabank at 4.74%, and fixed rates have been climbing since early September. I couldn't confirm an uninsured figure I'd stand behind, so insured or uninsured is what changes the number.
